articles.title: The restaking gold rush is over, and top protocols are barely making a profit
articles.snippet: As restaking yields dried up and smart-contract risks mounted, Ethereum's top liquid restaking protocol walked away from its core business to build a crypto neobank instead.

articles.title: THORChain rejects Bitget request to block hacker as $6 million moves to bitcoin
articles.snippet: CoinDesk found 27 successful swaps moving about 2,390 ETH into 75.2 BTC, even as Bitget urged THORChain to stop serving addresses tied to the $387.5 million theft.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to $83,000 while altcoins unwind Friday's rally
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell 1.7% to $83,000, though the CoinDesk 100 dropped 2.6% as Friday's biggest gainers reversed and oil climbed back above $100.

articles.title: Caution builds in the bitcoin market even as prices stay well above summer lows
articles.snippet: Overall demand for leveraged exposure remains weak, marked by sliding futures open interest. The capital that's still in the market appears skewed toward bearish positions.

articles.title: California's Newsom signs memecoin ban and calls it 'The Opposite of Trump'
articles.snippet: The California Governor signed AB 2409 as part of an anti-corruption package, framing it as a response to President Trump's $TRUMP fiasco.
